reason: A is the better proposal because Al addition has a physically plausible connection to a protective Al-rich tribo-oxide and extends prior observations to CoCrFeNi, whereas B largely repeats the cited 0.5 at.% W study while adding an unsupported claim that W-rich phases catalyze a lubricious oxide glaze. A still needs quantitative load/environment limits and must confront the likelihood that a continuous Al2O3-rich glaze will not form or provide low friction at room temperature.
